description: First anti-speculation package: bank LTV cap 80%; SSD on sales within 3 years; deemed income tax on gains within 3 years; no SGD housing loans for non-PR foreigners and foreign companies; BSD payable at option exercise
HDB owners subject to 5-year minimum occupation before buying private property
SSD suspended to improve market liquidity during Asian Financial Crisis
BSD payment deferred to TOP/completion for uncompleted properties
Deemed income tax on 3-year gains removed; non-PR foreigners and foreign companies allowed SGD housing loans (post dot-com and 9/11 support)
Bank LTV raised 80% to 90%; minimum cash down payment cut 10% to 5% (HDB bank-loan buyers aligned at 5%)
Deferred Payment Scheme for uncompleted private homes abolished
Interest Absorption Scheme and interest-only housing loans disallowed
SSD re-introduced for sales within 1 year; bank LTV cut 90% to 80%
SSD holding period 1 to 3 years; LTV for buyers with existing loan 80% to 70%; minimum cash 5% to 10% for them
SSD 4 years at 16/12/8/4%; LTV 60% for individuals with existing loan; 50% for non-individuals
ABSD introduced: foreigners and entities 10%; PR 2nd+ 3%; SC 3rd+ 3%
Loan tenure capped at 35 years; tighter LTV for tenure >30 years or beyond age 65
ABSD raised (SC 2nd 7% / 3rd 10%; PR 1st 5% / 2nd+ 10%; foreigners and entities 15%); tighter LTV for 2nd+ loans; min cash 25% for 2nd+ loans; MSR 30% for FI loans on HDB/EC
Total Debt Servicing Ratio framework introduced at 60%
HDB loan tenure 30 to 25 years; HDB MSR 35% to 30%; PR households must wait 3 years before buying resale HDB
30% MSR for EC bought from developers; resale levy for second-timer EC buyers
SSD cut to 3 years at 12/8/4%; TDSR disapplied to mortgage equity withdrawal loans at LTV <=50%
Top marginal BSD rate 4% on portion above $1m (Budget 2018)
ABSD +5pp individuals / +10pp entities (SC 2nd 12% / 3rd 15%; foreigners 20%; entities 25%); bank LTV cut 5pp (1st loan 75%)
Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (EHG) introduced for first-timer buyers (up to $80,000); HDB income ceilings raised to $14,000 for families and $7,000 for singles
ABSD raised (SC 2nd 17% / 3rd 25%; PR 2nd 25% / 3rd 30%; foreigners 30%; entities 35%); TDSR 60% to 55%; HDB loan LTV 90% to 85%
Residential property transferred into a living trust charged ABSD at the entity rate (ABSD Trust)
TDSR/MSR interest floor +0.5pp; 3% floor for HDB loans; HDB LTV 85% to 80%; 15-month wait-out for private owners buying non-subsidised HDB resale
BSD 5% on portion $1.5m-$3m and 6% above $3m (Budget 2023)
CPF Housing Grant for first-timer resale buyers increased (Budget 2023)
ABSD raised (SC 2nd 20% / 3rd 30%; PR 2nd 30% / 3rd 35%; foreigners 60%; entities 65%)
HDB loan LTV 80% to 75%; Enhanced CPF Housing Grant raised to up to $120,000 for first-timer families and $60,000 for singles
SSD holding period 3 to 4 years; rates +4pp (16/12/8/4%) for purchases from 4 Jul 2025
15-month wait-out for private owners buying non-subsidised HDB resale removed (after RPI fell in 1Q and 2Q 2026)
